requirements.text: The file src/slugify.ts exports a function slugify(title: string, options?: { maxLength?: number }): string.
slugify(title) returns the title with every letter in lowercase.
slugify(title) replaces each run of one or more whitespace characters with a single hyphen.

slugify(title) removes every character that is not a letter, a digit, a hyphen or whitespace (whitespace is covered by the whitespace requirement). Such characters are dropped, not replaced with a word or a hyphen.
The string returned by slugify never starts or ends with a hyphen.
slugify(title, { maxLength }) returns at most maxLength characters, cutting at the last hyphen before the limit when there is one.

meta.asked: Introduce one realistic bug into the implementation so that this requirement is no longer met for some inputs: "slugify(title) removes every character that is not a letter, a digit, a hyphen or whitespace (whitespace is covered by the whitespace requirement). Such characters are dropped, not replaced with a word or a hyphen.". Every other requirement must keep working. Change nothing else, and do not explain the change in comments or names.
